scope: Decision timing goal: actual product decoder, renderer and exact SAN click callbacks in Node/JSDOM. This is a delivery check, not a human comprehension or new engine trial.

negative_mutations.name: duplicate_action
negative_mutations.meaning: Duplicate a real owned action reference without changing its proof or prose.

negative_mutations.name: foreign_action
negative_mutations.meaning: Replace one action with an unadmitted line ID.

negative_mutations.name: action_not_owned_by_proof
negative_mutations.meaning: Use an admitted comparison occurrence that this unit does not own in proof_moves.

negative_mutations.name: missing_capture_price
negative_mutations.meaning: Keep the actual capture action, proof and prose; remove its coverage and change role to bypass only the cost-role shape guard.

negative_mutations.name: forged_required_ownership
negative_mutations.meaning: Assign an admitted occurrence as required although the unit does not own its proof.

negative_mutations.name: unknown_question_enum
negative_mutations.meaning: Replace a known question with an unknown tag.

negative_mutations.name: actions_require_typed_proof
negative_mutations.meaning: Retain action_moves but remove the typed proof list.

negative_mutations.name: unlisted_supplementary_reply
negative_mutations.meaning: Keep the supplementary reply in the answer but remove its admitted witness path.

negative_mutations.name: duplicate_witness_path
negative_mutations.meaning: Repeat an otherwise valid supplementary path.

negative_mutations.name: foreign_witness_path
negative_mutations.meaning: Replace one supplementary path with a nonexistent path.

negative_mutations.name: forged_focus_position
negative_mutations.meaning: Keep an owned focus occurrence but replace its certified position ID.

negative_mutations.name: missing_actual_recapture
negative_mutations.meaning: Keep an actual capture selected but omit its proven immediate recapture from action and coverage, preserving all proof and inline links.

negative_mutations.name: missing_actual_check_reply
negative_mutations.meaning: Remove a selected checking action’s next reply from the action account, preserving proof and inline notation; remove only the omitted action’s own coverage to reach closure validation.
